messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Service alert: sustained p99 > 3.5s on /v1/generate and gateway 504s detected across us-west & eu-west. Error budget threshold breached. Paging #incidents and oncall.

lina: saw the spike. Graphs show a step increase right after a deploy at ~11:22Z. Request queue depth on inference-gateway jumped and SYN backlog hints on a couple hosts.

deploy-bot: Deploy record: service=inference-gateway, release=2026-03-14T11:22:03Z, sha=b8d3f5c. Changes: multiplexer batching adjustments, kv-cache lifecycle tweak, traffic shaper update. Canary 100% proceeded to prod.

omar: I'm oncall. Collecting timelines and looking at host-level metrics. Initial quick check: no GPU OOMs, CPU steady, but per-request latencies from runtime show long tail and many proxy timeouts.

aditya: customer-facing note: csm-bot, can you surface any live incidents from large accounts? We should warn customers if request errors visible in their orgs.

csm-bot: Notified accounts with active rollouts: acme-corp, bright-ads. Waiting for replies.

samir: hypothesis: the batching tweak increases batch formation time for low QPS but long-seq requests, causing upstream backpressure and hitting gateway timeout window.

lina: adding that logs have repeated "kv-cache-miss" followed by slow path calls on some nodes. Could be a race where cache warmup + mux re-route increases latency per request.

omar: can someone scp a trace sample for a 504? I want the full hop timeline (gateway->router->runtime->backend).

aditya: grabbing traces now. Example trace id: trace-20260314-112245-a9. Gateway waited ~35s before returning 504, backend processing time shows many retries.

samir: that's consistent with retries piling up. We should cut the deploy until we understand.

lina: agreed. Propose immediate rollback to previous stable sha b7f2e1a. Also flip off the new batch gating flag remotely to see partial mitigation.

deploy-bot: Rollback command accepted. Job id rb-20260314-442. Manual flag flip recommended for faster mitigation.

omar: flipping flag for batching_gate to false on the control plane now.

```
adminctl feature-toggle set inference-gateway batching_gate false --env prod
```

omar: flag applied. Observing a modest drop in request queue depth but p99 still high (~2.8s). Proceeding with rollback in parallel.

deploy-bot: Rollback in progress to b7f2e1a. Estimated 90s.

lina: running smoke tests against /v1/generate (small prompt + long prompt) to replicate tail behavior.

```
# short
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"open-small","prompt":"hi"}'
# long
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"open-small","prompt":"<2000 token prompt>"}'
```

lina: short prompt 200 0.55s. long prompt currently 504 33.12s on pre-rollback hosts.

samir: okay once rollback completes, run parallel probes from multiple regions and recheck trace tails.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Job rb-20260314-442 finished. Traffic restored to b7f2e1a.

omar: re-running probes. short prompt 200 0.62s, long prompt 200 0.95s. p99 down to ~0.9s across regions. 504s dropping to near 0.

csm-bot: sent update to notified customers: "Issue traced to recent deploy, rollback completed, service restored. We'll follow up with details and timeline." Reactions: acme-corp acknowledged.

aditya: customer impact window estimate: 11:22Z -> 11:28Z (approx 6m). We'll confirm with richer logs but share preliminary window with CSMs.

lina: collecting debug logs and heap/profile dumps from affected hosts. Saved traces for postmortem and created a bucket: s3://redwood-incident-archives/2026/03/14/1812350000/

samir: initial root-cause suspect: batching gating interacts with mux path and KV cache lifecycle leading to long-lived requests on slow-path. Need replay tests with long sequence shapes in canary before reintroducing batching changes.

omar: creating follow-up tickets:
- PERF-928: add synthetic long-seq p99 gate to CI for inference-gateway
- INFRA-1022: audit kv-cache lifecycle and evictions under mux changes
- DEPLOY-1147: add automated rollback threshold for gateway 5xx > 1% in 5m

aditya: assigning postmortem owner to samir. He'll coordinate with platform and runtime teams and produce a blameless report.

lina: handing oncall to @samir for next shift. I'll add reproduction steps to the incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident closed by deploy-bot at 2026-03-14T11:31:40Z. Duration: ~9m. Follow-up owner: samir.

samir: acknowledged. I'll book a postmortem and invite runtime, infra, deploy, and devex. Also recommend temporary block on re-deploying the batching change until mitigations in place.

aditya: thanks everyone. Quick wins: add canary traffic shape test and pre-deploy perf check. We'll coordinate customer comms tomorrow with more details.

lina: :white_check_mark: Good catch. Let's keep the incident doc updated and avoid surprises in the next deploy.
